selection_contract: Use the current roots file when present or when no legacy roots file exists; otherwise use only the legacy root. Never scan or write both roots in one process.
migration_reason: New installations use the Converact product identity while existing signed RustDesk evidence roots remain readable during the compatibility window.
removal_condition: Remove the legacy root only after every supported Windows client and rollback generation has migrated its signed roots file and observed legacy-root use reaches zero.
